about: Measured per scene frame from the rendered dog layer (alpha centroid of the body card, bbox, luminance of the card: white = its blank back). x_screen/y_screen are in final film pixels (after the rostrum cut-in at frame 610); x_stage is before the camera. x_measured_m inverts x_stage = 300 + 185 x with a calibrated card-centroid offset (front -0.5 px, back -0.8 px).
